nuggets.text: Bob Chesney has been a head coach in Division III, Division II, the FCS and now the FBS.
Bob Chesney has not lost a season opener since 2019.
UCLA special assistant Richard Rodgers called 'The Play' in Cal's huddle in 1982 and handled the ball twice on the famous laterals.
Bob Chesney brought 26 staffers and 10 players with him from James Madison to UCLA.
Wayne Knight ran for three touchdowns in his UCLA debut, a 45-24 win at Cal.
Wayne Knight set a James Madison school record with 2,039 all-purpose yards in 2025.
UCLA's Sahir West set a Sun Belt Championship Game record with 5.5 tackles for loss last season at James Madison.
UCLA athletic director Tim Harris bought 300 tickets for Bruin fans to attend the home opener against San Diego State.
The Rose Bowl, UCLA's home since 1982, is the only stadium to host both the men's and women's World Cup finals.
Jackie Robinson played football for the Bruins in 1939 and 1940, years before he broke baseball's color barrier.
